description: This file defines the AccessToken class within the OAuth2 client library, representing an OAuth2 access token with methods for handling token data, expiration, and serialization.

classes.name: AccessToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token with methods for managing token data, expiration, and serialization.

methods.name: setTimeNow
methods.description: Sets the static time for testing purposes.

methods.name: resetTimeNow
methods.description: Resets the static test time to null.

methods.name: getTimeNow
methods.description: Returns the current time, either the static test time or the actual current time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AccessToken object with options including access_token, resource_owner_id, refresh_token, and expiration info.

methods.name: isExpirationTimestamp
methods.description: Determines if a given value is an expiration timestamp or a seconds-to-expire value.

methods.name: hasExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired based on current time.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the token as a string.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes token data to an array for JSON encoding.
